policies.title: Retained data has a cleanup task
policies.statement: Every table that holds retained personal data carries the `retained` tag and is deleted from by a scheduled task, so personal data is removed once its retention period ends. Covers GDPR storage limitation (no personal data kept longer than 2 years). The task must delete records older than the retention period; this check confirms a scheduled delete exists, not the cutoff it uses.

warnings.text: tags "retained" is on no table on this branch, so it selects nothing.
